papers.title_en: Optimistic Distributed Submodular Coordination with Applications to Multi-Target Tracking with Multiple Robots
papers.authors: Pranjal Sharma, Atharva Navsalkar, Zirui Xu, Vasileios Tzoumas
papers.evidence: 面向多机器人的分布式在线协调
papers.tldr: 面向多机器人多目标跟踪等动态环境，智能体需在未知且可能随动作演化的bandit环境中进行分布式子模协调。作者提出O-DOG算法，利用对目标运动与邻居动作的预测，让各智能体在时变网络上乐观并行决策。理论上给出跟踪遗憾界，其不超过无预测版本；预测足够准确时，即使最优动作每步变化，遗憾仍为次线性。还量化去中心化带来的次优性并验证仿真效果。
papers.abstract_en: We provide a distributed online algorithm for multi-agent submodular coordination in bandit environments, i.e., environments whose evolution is unknown a priori and may even adapt to the agents' actions. We are motivated by multi-robot tasks such as target tracking, where the optimal actions change over time and the agents must track them rather than a single fixed optimum. To address such problems, we provide the Optimistic Distributed Online Greedy (O-DOG) algorithm, that leverages predictions about the environment's behavior and improves regret guarantees. The agents select actions simultaneously over arbitrary, possibly time-varying, network topologies, and each agent acts optimistically, i.e., leveraging predictions of its upcoming rewards, e.g., from forecasts of the targets' motion and of its neighbors' actions. We bound O-DOG's tracking regret in terms of the agents' prediction error and the bound never exceeds its prediction-free counterpart. Particularly, it is sublinear even when the optimal action changes at every time step, provided the predictions are accurate enough. We further quantify the suboptimality due to decentralization as a function of the network structure, and show that accurate predictions accelerate convergence. We validate O-DOG in simulated multi-robot target tracking.

papers.title_en: FPTAS for Polygonal Multi-Robot Motion Planning
papers.authors: Sayan Bandyapadhyay, William Lochet, Saket Saurabh, Jie Xue
papers.evidence: 多边形环境中多机器人无碰撞最短运动规划
papers.tldr: 多机器人运动规划需在含障碍多边形环境中为多个多边形机器人寻找无碰撞最短路径，但已有结果仅覆盖两个单位正方形或近似双指标算法。本文针对任意固定数量k的平移多边形机器人，提出首个全多项式时间近似方案（FPTAS），可统一处理最小总路程、最小最大单机路程与最小完工时间三种目标。算法可直接推广到任意固定维度d的多面体环境与机器人，且显著简化了先前方法，解决了SODA'24与SODA'26提出的开放问题。
papers.abstract_en: We study multi-robot motion planning in a polygonal environment with polygonal robots. The setting of the problem consists of a polygonal domain $\mathcal{W}$ with $n$ vertices and $k$ robots $R_1,\dots,R_k$ translating in $\mathcal{W}$ each of which is represented by a polygon of constant complexity. Given a source configuration $\mathbf{s}$ and a target configuration $\mathbf{t}$ of the robots in $\mathcal{W}$, the goal of the problem is to find a collision-free motion plan from $\mathbf{s}$ to $\mathbf{t}$ that is shortest with respect to some cost function. We present the first fully polynomial-time approximation schemes (FPTAS) for motion planning with any fixed number $k$ of robots, under the min-sum objective, the min-max objective, and the min-makespan objective. Here, the min-sum variant aims to minimize the total traveling distance of all robots, the min-max variant aims to minimize the maximum traveling distance of a single robot, and the min-makespan variant aims to minimize the total time cost under the assumption that all robots move with a maximum speed $1$. The algorithm directly generalizes to the problem in any fixed dimension $d$, with a polytope environment and polytope robots. Our result settles an open question of Agarwal, Halperin, Sharir, Steiger [SODA'24] and Agarwal, Holmgren, Steiger [SODA'26], who gave an FPTAS for $k=2$ unit-square robots and a bicriteria-approximation algorithm for a fixed number $k$ of unit-square or unit-disk robots, respectively. Compared to the previous results, our algorithm is substantially simpler.

papers.title_en: DD-GBP: Anytime Multi-Arm Planning and Continuous Execution via Distributed Dynamic Gaussian Belief Propagation
papers.authors: Zhao Jin, Fengyi Dai, Yuetong Yin, Yunan Wang, Wenjie Chen, Chuxiong Hu
papers.evidence: 基于信念传播的分布式多机械臂规划与协调
papers.tldr: 针对复杂动态环境下长时程多臂任务在线安全执行难题，提出分布式动态高斯置信传播DD-GBP。它通过并行局部推理直接规划关节空间轨迹，以统一高斯过程参数化连接自适应规划时域、插值时间因子与连续执行，并借助动态子网重构和事件触发更新降低通信与推理开销。在50个移动障碍四臂场景中，全目标无碰撞完成率达92.5%，六类基线中最高；30臂无障场景保持99.87%成功率与15.80 ms平均热求解，超过60 Hz。该工作为动态场景在线长时程多臂规划建立了新SOTA。
papers.abstract_en: Safely executing long-horizon multi-arm tasks online in complex dynamic environments remains challenging. We propose a new distributed dynamic Gaussian belief propagation (DD-GBP) method that directly plans joint-space trajectories through parallel local inference. A unified Gaussian-process (GP) parameterization connects adaptive planning horizons, interpolation-time factors, and continuous execution. Each robot maintains a local tree-structured factor graph and exchanges messages asynchronously over active inter-arm links. Dynamic subnet reconstruction and event-triggered updates reduce communication and inference costs while responding to moving obstacles. We also provide theoretical analyses of local inference accuracy, anytime early stopping, triggered-replanning consistency, and GP-consistent execution.   In 50 long-horizon, multi-target four-arm scenes with moving obstacles, DD-GBP achieves $92.5\%$ collision-free all-target completion and the highest success rate among six representative baselines. Scenario ablations demonstrate long-horizon safety and robustness to communication impairment and extreme conditions; success remains $86.0\%$ under $90\%$ packet loss. Execution results further show substantially suppressed extreme velocity and acceleration peaks relative to Syn-GBP. On one workstation, obstacle-free tests with 30 coexisting arms retain $99.87\%$ success and a $15.80$ ms mean warm solve, exceeding 60 Hz and outperforming the compared methods in scalability. Dual-arm transport experiments under dynamic interference demonstrate online response and practical deployability. To the best of our knowledge, these results establish a new state of the art for online long-horizon multi-arm planning in dynamic scenes.

papers.title_en: Who to Trust in Multi-Robot Systems: Joint Robot and Object Hypothesis Trust Inference via Neural-Symbolic Cross-Validation
papers.authors: Ruiyang Wang, Hao-Lun Hsu, Haocheng Meng, Songqiao Xie, Miroslav Pajic
papers.evidence: 面向多机器人协作的信任推断
papers.tldr: 多机器人系统依赖信息共享与协调，但在部分可观测和对抗干扰下，判断机器人与物体假设的可信度十分关键。现有方法常需预设信任关系或侧信道信息。NeST-Bayes 仅利用机器人间观测一致性，通过神经符号框架联合推断机器人和假设信任，并用贝叶斯更新 Beta 信任信念。在攻击与遮挡场景中，它保持高精度与召回，提升保留信息的可靠性与覆盖度。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-robot systems (MRS) offer significant advantages over single-robot platforms by enabling information sharing and coordination for different tasks in complex environments. However, reliable cooperation critically depends on inferring trust over both information sources and their reported hypotheses, particularly under partial observability and potential adversarial interference. Existing approaches frequently depend on pre-established trust relationships or side-channel information, which may not be available or reliable in realistic MRS deployments. This work introduces NeST-Bayes, a neural-symbolic framework that jointly infers robot and hypothesis trust using only inter-robot observation consistency, without requiring preassigned robot trust, reputation information, or side-channel identity signals. NeST-Bayes infers instantaneous trust evidence scores for robots and object hypotheses by reasoning over ego-centric relational graphs constructed from cross-robot observation consistency. These evidence scores are accumulated over time through Bayesian updates of Beta-distributed trust beliefs to maintain temporally consistent trust estimates. Extensive evaluations show that NeST-Bayes achieves the highest mean object precision and robot recall across all benchmark settings, and the highest robot precision and object recall in most settings, compared to trust-based methods. Under aggressive optimized attacks, it achieves 98.8\% robot precision with 93.8\% recall and 98.3\% object precision with 95.4\% recall. In an occlusion-rich Webots warehouse, it maintains 92.5\% robot precision with 92.0\% recall and 97.3\% object precision with 85.0\% recall. These results demonstrate joint improvements in the reliability and coverage of retained information.

papers.title_en: Distributed area coverage path planning subject to the inclusion of a headland path
papers.evidence: 多机器人分布式区域覆盖路径规划
papers.tldr: 面向含障碍的非凸农田区域，多机器人协同全覆盖需兼顾地头路径与机具约束。本文提出一种确定性分布式区域覆盖路径规划方法，在作业幅宽、作业/续航能力、非完整动力学及起止库位分配等限制下，为每台机具生成协同路径并实现全覆盖。方法支持库位约束变化，并指出无约束库位分配可获得全局最优解。结果表明纳入地头路径对覆盖至关重要，且相较传统Boustrophedon模式更具优势。
papers.abstract_en: A deterministic method for the problem of distributed area coverage path planning subject to the inclusion of a headland path is presented. Given a, in general, non-convex area to be covered that may, in general, include obstacle areas, multiple robots, at least one robot depot, and constraints on each machinery such as a working width, work capacity limits, travel capacity limits, nonholonomic dynamical constraints and, possibly, a robot start and end depot assignment, distributed paths for each machinery are calculated that collectively enable full area coverage. Variations are discussed, in particular, a scenario where unconstrained depots assignment can attain a global optimal solution to the problem. The importance of inclusion of a headland path for area coverage, as well as the benefits in comparison to an alternative Boustrophedon-pattern based approach are highlighted.

papers.title_en: HM3D-M3: A Benchmark for Multi-Agent, Multi-Modal, Multi-Object Goal Navigation
papers.authors: Hongyu Ding, Kanyu Xu, Mingjia Chen, Zixuan Chen, Jieqi Shi, Jing Huo, Yifan Zhang, Yang Gao
papers.evidence: 多智能体多模态多目标导航基准
papers.tldr: 现有基准只单独研究多智能体、多模态或多目标导航，缺少将三者置于同一回合的评测。为此提出HM3D-M3：K个智能体从逼真室内场景不同位置出发，寻找以开放词汇类别、实例图像或实例描述给出的无序目标集合。基准含1000个验证回合、3926个目标和379个开放词汇类别，并提供团队级SR与归一化SPL。适配多机器人与零样本方法仅16-27%成功率，HiGA和LaViRA-M3达38-41%，并已在异构三机器人团队部署。
papers.abstract_en: Rapid progress in AI agents and robotics makes it a matter of the near future that humans are served by a team of robots. Such a team will receive several goals at once, each specified in whatever form is convenient for the human, such as a category name, a photo, or a spoken description. Existing benchmarks study multi-agent, multi-modal, and multi-object goal navigation in isolation, and a benchmark that places all three in one episode is missing. To fill this gap, we introduce HM3D-M3. A team of K agents starts at distributed locations in a photorealistic indoor scene and searches for an unordered set of M object goals, each given as an open-vocabulary category, an instance image, or an instance description. HM3D-M3 provides 1,000 validation episodes over 3,926 goals from 379 open-vocabulary categories, 100K observation-assignment training samples, and two team-level metrics, goal-level SR and makespan-normalized SPL. We further contribute two baselines. HiGA is a trained hierarchical goal assigner on top of a frozen open-vocabulary navigation policy, and LaViRA-M3 is a training-free team of VLM agents with shared mapping and progress analysis. Adapted multi-robot and zero-shot methods reach 16--27% SR, while our baselines reach 38--41% with complementary strengths and distinct failure modes. Furthermore, we deploy LaViRA-M3 on a heterogeneous three-robot team. Project page: https://robo-lavira.github.io/hm3d-m3/

papers.title_en: Competitive Task Allocation with Temporal Proposal Windows and Improved Artificial Potential Fields for Dual-Arm Industrial Manipulation
papers.authors: Surya Prakash S. K, Bhuvan Narula, Jagannath Prasad Sahoo, Jayakumar VK, Praful Hambarde, Amit Shukla
papers.evidence: 面向双臂工业操作的任务分配与无碰撞运动规划
papers.tldr: 面向双臂工业操作中固定轨迹与刚性分配导致空间利用率低、碰撞风险高的问题，提出基于距离的竞争式任务分配框架，融合实时视觉感知与无碰撞运动规划。通过五帧时间窗口让各臂评估目标后择优，并采用改进人工势场实现协调运动。仿真与Kinova Gen3 Lite实验显示，同构场景平均速度提升约47%且零碰撞，混合场景约11%时间开销换取更高安全性，并集成YOLOv8 OBB检测与10 Hz控制回路，验证工业装配分拣部署可行性。
papers.abstract_en: Modern industrial automation demands autonomous collaborative systems capable of coordinated manipulation in workspaces with heterogeneous object arrangements. Existing systems rely on predetermined trajectories and rigid allocation strategies, causing suboptimal workspace utilization and collision risks. This paper presents a distance-based competitive task allocation framework for dual-arm systems, integrating real-time vision perception with collision-free motion planning. A temporal window mechanism enables each arm to evaluate object detections over five consecutive vision frames before committing to optimal distance-based selection, featuring dynamic reallocation and spatial conflict resolution at 0.01m threshold accuracy. An improved Artificial Potential Field (iAPF) framework provides coordinated dual-arm movements through exponential goal attraction, inter-arm repulsion, home-seeking, and velocity damping forces. Simulation results validate superiority over market-based, round-robin, and fixed allocation strategies in distance efficiency, collision risk, and workspace coverage. Hardware experiments using two 6-DOF Kinova Gen3 Lite manipulators demonstrate approximately 47% average velocity improvement over fixed allocation in homogeneous scenarios with zero collisions, while mixed object scenarios confirm universal handling with approximately 11% time overhead offset by superior safety margins. The framework integrates YOLOv8 OBB detection at 30 FPS with 10 Hz control loops, demonstrating practical deployment capability for industrial assembly and sorting operations.

papers.title_en: PopGen: Generating Semantically Diverse Populations for Zero-Shot Coordination
papers.authors: Paul Teiletche, Kanghyun Ryu, Kyungjoon Park, Dhruva Tirumala, Markus Wulfmeier, Negar Mehr
papers.evidence: 通过多样化行为生成实现多智能体协调
papers.tldr: 多智能体强化学习中，训练时接触多样策略伙伴对测试协作至关重要，但现有方法常用轨迹级代理衡量多样性，可能把同一策略的不同轨迹误判为多样。PopGen 借助 LLM 识别高层策略，从零合成语义多样智能体：先生成行为文本描述，再转译为可执行代码策略。在四个协作环境中，PopGen 种群训练的协作者对未见伙伴实现稳健零样本协作，优于种群博弈基线；语义多样性随规模提升最差表现。该工作表明 LLM 能生成高质量多样种群，并给出兼顾质量与多样性的设计选择。
papers.abstract_en: In multi-agent reinforcement learning, exposing a cooperator to partners with diverse strategies during training is key to better collaboration at test time. However, existing methods typically rely on trajectory-level proxies to measure diversity, which may label two distinct trajectories of the same strategy as diverse. Instead, our key insight is to leverage LLMs' ability to describe behaviorally distinct agents in environments, similar to how humans can recognize high-level strategies. To this end, we introduce PopGen, a framework that synthesizes semantically diverse agents from scratch using LLMs. PopGen first generates a diverse set of textual descriptions of agent behaviors, then translates each behavior into a code policy that can be executed within the environment. We show that cooperators trained against PopGen populations achieve robust zero-shot cooperation with unseen partners, outperforming population-play baselines across four collaborative environments. We further show that semantic diversity scales with PopGen population size, improving the cooperator's worst-case performance, and we identify design choices that preserve population quality while maximizing diversity. Our code is available at https://github.com/labicon/PopGen.

papers.title_en: A Minimum Exact Disjunctive Basis for Two-Robot Solvability Profiles
papers.authors: Tsukasa Ninomiya, Shota Naito, Naoki Kitamura, Yuichi Sudo, Koichi Wada
papers.evidence: 双自主移动机器人的可解性剖面刻画
papers.tldr: 论文研究平面中两台自主移动机器人在可变朝向、手性与刚性运动下任务的可解性剖面。作者借助十三类计算能力的商序Q，证明所有上集均可实现，并构造由十三项具体任务组成的最小精确析取基。对任意反链，对应任务析取后的剖面恰等于各自剖面之并；通过为每个目标外极大类算法构造单一公平执行，同时违反所有选中谓词来保证精确性。最终可实现剖面构成有限分配格Up(Q)，共54种，且每项可由至多三个主任务规范表示，该基在剖面层面最小且唯一。
papers.abstract_en: We completely characterize the solvability profiles of tasks for two autonomous mobile robots in the plane under variable disorientation, chirality, and rigid movements. The four standard capability models and the schedulers considered here have a known quotient order Q of thirteen computational classes. A task's solvability profile is the set of classes in which it is solvable, and is necessarily an upset of Q. We prove that every upset is realizable and construct a minimum exact disjunctive basis of thirteen concrete tasks.   The basis contains one task for each principal upset. For every antichain of Q, the disjunction of the corresponding tasks has profile exactly equal to the union of their profiles. This exactness is not implied by the individual profiles: an algorithm may satisfy different disjuncts in different executions. We establish it by constructing, for every algorithm in each maximal class outside the target union, a single admissible fair execution violating all selected predicates simultaneously. Consequently, the realizable profiles form the entire finite distributive lattice Up(Q): there are exactly 54 profiles, counted by the antichain polynomial 1 + 13z + 24z^2 + 16z^3, and each has a canonical disjunctive representation using at most three principal tasks.   We also identify six tasks whose solvability signatures recover every inclusion and incomparability in Q, and prove that six is minimum even among arbitrary separating tasks. Their profiles are precisely the principal upsets generated by the join-irreducible elements of Q. In contrast, any task family generating every profile by exact disjunctions must contain all thirteen principal profiles. Thus our exact disjunctive basis has minimum size and is unique at the profile level.
